sentences.en: This is the story of Joe and Fonzie.
sentences.zh: 这是乔和方齐的故事。

sentences.en: It’s a story about a friendship that started more than 20 years ago.
sentences.zh: 这是一个开始于 20 多年前的友谊故事。

sentences.en: It’s also a story about a friendship that saved a life and started a new kind of help for people with problems.
sentences.zh: 这也是一个拯救了一条生命、并开创了一种帮助有困难的人的新方式的故事。

sentences.en: ‘Joe’ is Joe Hoagland, who was three years old when the story began.
sentences.zh: “乔”是指乔·霍格兰，故事开始时他三岁。

sentences.en: And ‘Fonzie’ is a 3-metre-long, 275 kilogram dolphin.
sentences.zh: 而“方齐”是一头 3 米长、275 公斤的海豚。

sentences.en: When Joe was born, he had a problem with his heart and doctors had to operate on him.
sentences.zh: 乔出生时心脏有问题，医生不得不给他做手术。

sentences.en: When he was three, he had another operation.
sentences.zh: 他三岁时又做了一次手术。

sentences.en: This operation didn’t go well and he became paralysed – he couldn’t move the left side of his body.
sentences.zh: 那次手术不太顺利，他瘫痪了——身体左侧无法动弹。

sentences.en: The doctors at the hospital didn’t think he could get better.
sentences.zh: 医院里的医生都认为他好不了了。

sentences.en: Deena, Joe’s mother, took him to different places for therapy, but it wasn’t very successful.
sentences.zh: 乔的妈妈迪娜带他去不同地方做康复治疗，但效果都不太好。

sentences.en: Then the family moved to Florida.
sentences.zh: 后来一家人搬到了佛罗里达。

sentences.en: Joe liked being in the water and Deena thought swimming could help him.
sentences.zh: 乔喜欢待在水里，迪娜觉得游泳对他有帮助。

sentences.en: First, they went to swimming pools in hotels, but some hotel guests didn’t like them being there.
sentences.zh: 起初，他们去酒店的游泳池，但有些客人不喜欢他们在那里。

sentences.en: Then one day she went with Joe to a place in Key Largo called Dolphin Plus, where people swam with dolphins.
sentences.zh: 后来有一天，她带乔去了基拉戈一个叫“海豚之家”的地方，那里的人可以和海豚一起游泳。

sentences.en: Joe met Fonzie there and the story really began.
sentences.zh: 乔在那里认识了方齐，故事才真正开始。

sentences.en: Soon, Joe wanted to see Fonzie every day.
sentences.zh: 很快，乔每天都想见到方齐。

sentences.en: He loved playing with him and feeding him.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢和方齐一起玩、喂它吃东西。

sentences.en: Every time that Joe arrived, Fonzie came to see him.
sentences.zh: 每次乔到来，方齐都会过来见他。

sentences.en: Joe’s mother told him always to feed Fonzie using his left hand, so Joe used his left side more and more.
sentences.zh: 乔的妈妈告诉他喂食时一定要用左手，于是乔越来越多地使用左侧身体。

sentences.en: Slowly, he got better and better.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，他一天比一天好。

sentences.en: He’s now over 30 years old and very well.
sentences.zh: 他现在 30 多岁了，身体很好。

sentences.en: Deena saw that Joe’s friendship with Fonzie helped him a lot, and she knew it was a good idea for other people, too.
sentences.zh: 迪娜看到乔和方齐的友谊帮了他很大的忙，她知道这对其他人也是个好主意。

sentences.en: So, she and her family worked to open a place called Island Dolphin Care.
sentences.zh: 于是她和家人努力开设了一个叫“岛屿海豚关爱中心”的地方。

sentences.en: It’s next to Dolphin Plus and many people with health problems come to spend time with the dolphins.
sentences.zh: 它就在海豚之家旁边，很多有健康问题的人会来这里和海豚相处。

sentences.en: Sadly, Fonzie died in 2004 when Joe was 17.
sentences.zh: 令人难过的是，方齐在 2004 年去世了，那时乔 17 岁。

sentences.en: He wrote: ‘Fonzie was a great friend to me; he and I shared a lot of good times.
sentences.zh: 他写道：“方齐是我很好的朋友；我们一起度过了很多美好时光。

sentences.en: He always put a smile on my face.’
sentences.zh: 它总是在我脸上带来笑容。”
